alternativesConsidered.notes: Authorized ebook preview page for the same 2015 work family. Useful for lawful metadata support, but the print-first Open Library record is better for chapter-map stability.

alternativesConsidered.name: 2017 St. Martin's / Macmillan new edition page
alternativesConsidered.notes: Official work-family page with a lawful excerpt from the first numbered chapter. It appears to be a newer edition variant and is useful for excerpt support, but the 2015 first edition remains the cleaner chapter-map lock.

decisionRationale: Open Library exposes the 2015 first-edition print identifiers and the full package table of contents, which is the most stable source for chapter numbering in this run.
Google Books confirms the same 2015 work family and core thesis without indicating a materially different chapter order.
Macmillan's newer official page supports the same core text family and offers a lawful excerpt, but it is not needed as the chapter-map lock because it reflects a newer edition context.
No translation or materially different chapter structure was found that would change chapter order, chapter scope, or chapter-level interpretation.
